key_features: Protect Your Vinyl Jackets – Safeguard LP covers from dust, scratches, scuffs, and everyday wear with Hudson Hi-Fi archival-grade outer sleeves designed for long-term record care.

Designed for Flexibility, Not Stiffness – Purposefully engineered 2 × 3 mil (6 mil total) thickness for clarity and easy handling. These sleeves bend with your jackets to help resist seam splitting and corner stress.
Crystal Clear Archival-Grade Polypropylene – Ultra-clear, low-haze PP material preserves original album artwork while remaining anti-static and acid-free for safe, long-term storage.
Sized for Standard 12” LP Jackets – Outer sleeve dimensions measure 12.75 × 12.75 inches (324 × 324 mm) for smooth insertion, proper coverage, and shelf-friendly storage.
Easy to Use & Collector Approved – Slides on smoothly without forcing corners or bowing jackets; ideal for everyday listening collections and available in multi-pack options.
